# dobo-knex

Official `knex.js` adapter for [Dobo Framework](https://ardhi.github.io/dobo). This adapter provides a set of common methods to interact with the database using Knex.js.

It is the foundation of many other official adapters including:
- [dobo-mysql](https://ardhi.github.io/dobo-mysql)
- [dobo-postgresql](https://ardhi.github.io/dobo-postgresql)
- [dobo-sqlite3](https://ardhi.github.io/dobo-sqlite3)
- [dobo-clickhouse](https://ardhi.github.io/dobo-clickhouse)

You should NOT use this adapter directly in your project. Instead, use one of the official adapters listed above that is compatible with your database.
